properties.description:
Sink dataset for writing blob source files (config XML, invoice PDFs, report JSON) to the Gold ADLS Gen2 container.

Mirrors ds_bronze_blob_sink — same structure, different linked service and fileSystem.

Linked service : ls_adls_gold  (points to the gold container)
Parameter      : p_folder — set by each copy activity, e.g.
                   gold-blob/config/load_type=full
                   gold-blob/invoices/ingestion_date=2025-10-24
                   gold-blob/reports/ingestion_date=2025-10
